pulihora.title: Pulihora
pulihora.description: Pulihora, also known as Pulisoru, Pulinchoru, Puliyogare, Puliyodarai, Ambad Baath, Kokum rice, or simply Tamarind rice, is a common and traditional rice preparation in the South Indian states of Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Tamil Nadu and Karnataka.
pulihora.name: Pulihora

pesarattu.title: Pesarattu
pesarattu.description: Pesarattu, pesara attu, pesara dosa, or cheeldo is a crepe-like bread, originating in Andhra Pradesh, India, that is a variety of dosa.
pesarattu.name: Pesarattu

dosa.title: Dosa (food)
dosa.description: A dosa or thosai is a thin, savoury batter bread in South Indian cuisine made from a fermented batter of ground black gram and rice.
dosa.name: Dosa (food)

idli.title: Idli
idli.description: Idli or idly is a South Indian and Sri Lankan rice cake popular as a breakfast food.
idli.name: Idli

upma.title: Upma
upma.description: Upma, uppumavu, uppindi, kharabath, upit, upeet, rulanv, uppuma, or uppittu is a dish of thick porridge from dry-roasted semolina or coarse rice flour.
upma.name: Upma

dal.title: Dal
dal.description: In South Asian cuisine, dal are dried, split pulses that do or do not require soaking before cooking.
dal.name: Dal (pappu)

sambar.title: Sambar (dish)
sambar.description: Sāmbār, or sambhar, is a lentil-based vegetable spiced curry or stew, cooked with pigeon peas and tamarind broth.
sambar.name: Sambar (dish)

curd_rice.title: Curd rice
curd_rice.description: Curd rice or yogurt rice is a dish originating from India.
curd_rice.name: Curd rice

avakaya.title: Avakaya
avakaya.description: Avakaya is a traditional pickle originating from the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh.
avakaya.name: Avakaya

gongura.title: Gongura
gongura.description: Gongura, or Puntikura, or Gogaaku is a variety of the roselle plant grown for its edible leaves in India and in other countries like Fiji.
gongura.name: Gongura

biryani.title: Hyderabadi biryani
biryani.description: Hyderabadi biryani is a style of biryani originating from Hyderabad, India made with basmati rice and meat.
biryani.name: Biryani

laddu.title: Laddu
laddu.description: Laddu, or laddoo, is a spherical sweet from the Indian subcontinent made of various ingredients and sugar syrup or jaggery.
laddu.name: Laddu

ariselu.title: Adhirasam
ariselu.description:
Adhirasam, attarasalu,, kajjaya or athrasa in Kannada, ariselu in Telugu, anarasa in Marathi, Airsa in Chhattisgarhi or Arisa pitha in Odia is a type of Indian sweet made out of 
rice, jaggery, ghee and sometimes coconut and with spices like cardamom, sesame, pepper and ginger powder from Tamil cuisine, Karnataka cuisine, Telugu cuisine, Marathi cuisine and Odia cuisine. The doughnut-like fried dough has a long history of popularity in Kannada, Telugu, Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and Tamil civilization. They are similar in shape to vada, but are not savoury and are eaten as a sweet.
ariselu.name: Ariselu

bobbatlu.title: Puran poli
bobbatlu.description: Puran poli is an Indian sweet flatbread that is popular in South India and mainly in the state of Maharashtra.
bobbatlu.name: Bobbatlu

chapati.title: Chapati
chapati.description: Chapati is an unleavened flatbread originating from the Indian subcontinent.
chapati.name: Chapati

payasam.title: Kheer
payasam.description: Kheer, khir, payesh, fenni, or payasam is a pudding or porridge popular in the Indian subcontinent, usually made by boiling milk, sugar or jaggery, and rice.
payasam.name: Payasam

murukku.title: Murukku
murukku.description: Muṟukku is a savoury, crunchy snack originating from the Indian subcontinent.
murukku.name: Murukku (jantikalu)

pongal_dish.title: Pongal (dish)
pongal_dish.description: Pongal is a dish of rice cooked in boiling milk.
pongal_dish.name: Pongal (dish)

vada.title: Medu vada
vada.description: Medu vada is a South Indian breakfast snack made from Vigna mungo.
vada.name: Vada (garelu)

pani_puri.title: Panipuri
pani_puri.description: Panipuri is a snack associated with the cuisines of the Indian subcontinent consisting of a deep-fried spherical puri shell, hollowed out for a filling and dipped in flavoured waters.
pani_puri.name: Panipuri

samosa.title: Samosa
samosa.description: A samosa or shingara is a fried Indian subcontinent turnover with a savoury filling that mostly consists of vegetables like spiced potatoes, onions, and peas, but can include cheese such as paneer, meat or even fish.
samosa.name: Samosa

jalebi.title: Jalebi
jalebi.description: Jalebi is a common sweet snack in South Asia, West Asia and some parts of Africa.
jalebi.name: Jalebi

gulab_jamun.title: Gulab jamun
gulab_jamun.description: Gulab jamun is a sweet dessert or mithai which had originated in the Indian subcontinent, and is popular in India, Bangladesh, Nepal, Pakistan and Burmese cuisines.
gulab_jamun.name: Gulab jamun

paneer.title: Paneer
paneer.description: Paneer is a fresh acid-set cheese, common in South Asian cuisine, made from cow milk or buffalo milk.
paneer.name: Paneer

paneer_curry.title: Palak paneer
paneer_curry.description: Palak paneer or palak chhena is a dish from the Indian subcontinent consisting of chhena or paneer in a thick paste made from puréed spinach, called palak in Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi and other Indian languages.
paneer_curry.name: Paneer curry

chole.title: Chole bhature
chole.description: Chole bhature is a dish pairing chickpea curry with bhatura, a deep-fried flatbread.
chole.name: Chole

paratha.title: Paratha
paratha.description: Paratha is a flatbread from the Indian subcontinent, consisting of a wheat dough, typically whole wheat, that is folded and rolled with ghee, forming multiple layers, and shallow fried.
paratha.name: Paratha

naan.title: Naan
naan.description: Naan is a leavened, oven-baked or tawa-fried flatbread, that can also be baked in a tandoor.
naan.name: Naan

indian_pickle.title: South Asian pickle
indian_pickle.description: South Asian pickles, known as achar among other names, are pickled and often highly spiced condiments made from a variety of vegetables and fruits preserved in brine, vinegar, edible oils, and South Asian spices.
indian_pickle.name: Pickle

chutney.title: Chutney
chutney.description: A chutney is a condiment associated with cuisines of the Indian subcontinent.
chutney.name: Pachadi (chutney)

papadum.title: Papadam
papadum.description: A papadam is a snack that originated in the Indian subcontinent.
papadum.name: Papadam

halwa.title: Gajar ka halwa
halwa.description: Gajar ka halwa, also known as gajorer halwa, gajarno halwo, gajar pak, and carrot pudding, is a type of halva, an Indian dessert, made by placing grated carrots in a pot containing a specific amount of water, milk, sugar, and cardamom and then cooking with ghee while stirring regularly.
halwa.name: Halwa

mysore_pak.title: Mysore pak
mysore_pak.description: Mysore pak is a traditional Indian confectionery made primarily from gram flour (besan), sugar, and ghee and often flavoured with cardamom.
mysore_pak.name: Mysore pak

kaju_katli.title: Kaju katli
kaju_katli.description: Kaju katli is an Indian dessert.
kaju_katli.name: Kaju katli

lassi.title: Lassi
lassi.description: Lassi is a yogurt–based beverage with a smoothie-like consistency.
lassi.name: Lassi

chai.title: Masala chai
chai.description: Masala chai is a popular beverage originating from India.
chai.name: Masala chai

filter_coffee.title: Indian filter coffee
filter_coffee.description: Indian filter coffee is a coffee drink made by mixing hot milk and sugar with the infusion obtained by percolation brewing of finely ground coffee powder with chicory in a traditional Indian filter. It has been described as "hot, strong, sweet and topped with bubbly froth" and is known as filter kaapi in India.
filter_coffee.name: Indian filter coffee

coconut_water.title: Coconut water
coconut_water.description: Coconut water is the clear liquid inside young coconuts.
coconut_water.name: Tender coconut

jaggery.title: Jaggery
jaggery.description: Jaggery is a traditional non-centrifugal cane sugar consumed in South Asia, Southeast Asia, North America, Central America, Brazil and parts of Africa.
jaggery.name: Jaggery

mango.title: Mango
mango.description: A mango is an edible stone fruit produced by the tropical tree Mangifera indica.
mango.name: Mango

banana.title: Banana
banana.description: A banana is an elongated, edible fruit that is botanically a berry produced by several kinds of large treelike herbaceous flowering plants in the genus Musa.
banana.name: Banana

jackfruit.title: Jackfruit
jackfruit.description: The jackfruit or jakfruit is a fruit tree in the mulberry family of Moraceae.
jackfruit.name: Jackfruit

guava.title: Guava
guava.description: Guava, also known as the 'guava-pear' in various regions, is a common tropical fruit cultivated in many tropical and subtropical regions.
guava.name: Guava

sugarcane.title: Sugarcane juice
sugarcane.description: Sugarcane juice is the liquid extracted from pressed sugarcane.
sugarcane.name: Sugarcane juice

pav_bhaji.title: Pav bhaji
pav_bhaji.description: Pav bhaji, or pao bhaji is a staple food of Maharashtra, consisting of a thick spicy vegetable curry (bhaji) served with a soft, buttered bread roll (pav).
pav_bhaji.name: Pav bhaji

uttapam.title: Uttapam
uttapam.description: An uttapam, uthappam, oothappam, uthapam, utapam or uttappam is a type of dosa from South India.
uttapam.name: Uttapam

poha.title: Flattened rice
poha.description: Flattened rice is a preparation of rice made from raw, toasted, or parboiled rice grains pounded into flat flakes.
poha.name: Poha (atukulu)

pakora.title: Pakora
pakora.description: Pakora is a fritter originating from the Indian subcontinent.
pakora.name: Bajji (pakora)

kulfi.title: Kulfi
kulfi.description: Kulfi is a frozen dairy dessert from the Indian subcontinent.
kulfi.name: Kulfi

prasadam.title: Prasada
prasadam.description: Prasāda, prasad or prasadam is a religious offering in Hinduism.
prasadam.name: Prasadam

pulao.title: Pilaf
pulao.description: Pilaf is a rice dish, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as vegetables and meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere.
pulao.name: Pulao

tamarind.title: Tamarind
tamarind.description: Tamarind is a leguminous tree bearing edible fruit that is indigenous to tropical Africa and naturalized in Asia.
tamarind.name: Tamarind

curry_leaves.title: Curry tree
curry_leaves.description: Bergera koenigii, synonym Murraya koenigii, and commonly known as curry tree, curry bush or sweet neem, is a tree in the citrus family Rutaceae, first described by Carl Linnaeus in 1767.
curry_leaves.name: Curry leaves

ragi.title: Finger millet
ragi.description: Finger millet is an annual herbaceous plant.
ragi.name: Ragi

thali.title: Thali
thali.description: Thali or bhojanam is a round platter used to serve food in South Asia, Southeast Asia and the Caribbean.
thali.name: Full meal (bhojanam)

rice.title: Cooked rice
rice.description: Cooked rice refers to rice that has been cooked either by steaming or boiling.
rice.name: Rice (annam)

curry.title: Curry
curry.description: Curry is a dish with a spicy sauce, initially in Indian cuisine, then modified by interchange with the Portuguese, followed by the British, and eventually thoroughly internationalised.
curry.name: Curry (kura)

auto.title: Auto rickshaw
auto.description: An auto rickshaw is a motorized version of the pulled rickshaw or cycle rickshaw.
auto.name: Auto rickshaw

rickshaw.title: Cycle rickshaw
rickshaw.description: The cycle rickshaw is a small-scale means of local transport.
rickshaw.name: Cycle rickshaw

bullock_cart.title: Bullock cart
bullock_cart.description: A bullock cart or ox cart is a two-wheeled or four-wheeled vehicle pulled by oxen.
bullock_cart.name: Bullock cart

scooter.title: Scooter (motorcycle)
scooter.description: A scooter or motor scooter is a motorcycle with an underbone or step-through frame, a seat, and a platform for the rider's feet.
scooter.name: Scooter (motorcycle)

gopuram.title: Gopuram
gopuram.description: A gopuram or gopura is a monumental, usually ornate entrance tower of a Hindu temple in the Dravidian architecture of South India and Sri Lanka.
gopuram.name: Gopuram

paddy_field.title: Paddy field
paddy_field.description: A paddy field is a flooded field of arable land used for growing semiaquatic crops, most notably rice and taro.
paddy_field.name: Paddy field (polam)

well.title: Well
well.description: A well is an excavation or structure created on the earth by digging, driving, or drilling to access liquid resources, usually water.
well.name: Well

tulsi.title: Ocimum tenuiflorum
tulsi.description: Ocimum tenuiflorum, commonly known as tulasi, tulsi, or holy basil, is an aromatic perennial plant in the family Lamiaceae.
tulsi.name: Tulsi (holy basil)

banyan.title: Banyan
banyan.description: A banyan, also spelled banian, is a fig that develops accessory trunks from adjacent prop roots, allowing the tree to spread outwards indefinitely.
banyan.name: Banyan

neem.title: Azadirachta indica
neem.description: Azadirachta indica, commonly known as neem, margosa, nimtree or Indian lilac, is a tree in the Mahogany family Meliaceae.
neem.name: Neem tree

coconut_tree.title: Coconut
coconut_tree.description: The coconut is a member of the palm family (Arecaceae) and the only living species of the genus Cocos.
coconut_tree.name: Coconut

cow.title: Zebu
cow.description: The zebu, also known as indicine cattle and humped cattle, is a species or subspecies of domestic cattle originating in South Asia.
cow.name: Cow

buffalo.title: Water buffalo
buffalo.description: The water buffalo, also called domestic water buffalo, Asian water buffalo, and Asiatic water buffalo, is a large domesticated bovine originating in South and Southeast Asia descended from the wild water buffalo.
buffalo.name: Water buffalo

peacock.title: Indian peafowl
peacock.description: The Indian peafowl, also known as the common peafowl, or blue peafowl, is a species of peafowl native to the Indian subcontinent.
peacock.name: Indian peafowl

charminar.title: Charminar
charminar.description: The Charminar is a monument located in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.
charminar.name: Charminar

tirupati.title: Venkateswara Temple, Tirumala
tirupati.description: The Venkateswara Swami Temple—also known as Tirumala Temple, Tirupati Temple and Tirupati Balaji Temple—is a Hindu temple located in the hills of Tirumala, within Tirupati Urban Mandal, Tirupati district, Andhra Pradesh, India.
tirupati.name: Tirupati temple

saree.title: Sari
saree.description: A sari is a draped cloth and women's garment in the Indian subcontinent.
saree.name: Sari

silk_saree.title: Kanchipuram silk sari
silk_saree.description: The Kanchipuram silk sari, also called Kanjeevaram sari is a type of silk sari made in the Kanchipuram region in Tamil Nadu, India.
silk_saree.name: Pattu saree

kurta.title: Kurta
kurta.description: A kurta is a loose collarless shirt or tunic worn in many regions of South Asia, and now also worn around the world.
kurta.name: Kurta

lungi.title: Lungi
lungi.description: The lungi is a clothing similar to the sarong that originated in the Indian subcontinent.
lungi.name: Lungi

bangles.title: Bangle
bangles.description: A bangle is a traditionally rigid bracelet which is usually made of metal, wood, glass or plastic.
bangles.name: Bangles (gajulu)

bindi.title: Bindi
bindi.description: A bindi is a coloured dot or, in modern times, a sticker worn on the centre of the forehead, by Hindus, Jains, and Buddhists from the Indian subcontinent.
bindi.name: Bindi (bottu)

mangalsutra.title: Mangalasutra
mangalsutra.description: A mangala sutra, or tali, is a necklace worn by certain groups of married women from the Indian subcontinent.
mangalsutra.name: Mangalasutra

anklet.title: Anklet
anklet.description: An anklet, also called ankle chain, ankle bracelet or ankle string, is an ornament worn around the ankle.
anklet.name: Anklet

mehndi.title: Mehndi
mehndi.description: Mehndi or mehendi is a form of temporary skin decoration using a paste created with henna.
mehndi.name: Mehndi

sankranti.title: Makar Sankranti
sankranti.description: Makar(a) Sankrānti also referred to as Uttarāyana, Makara, or simply Sankrānti, is a Hindu observance and a mid-winter harvest festival in India and Nepal.
sankranti.name: Sankranti

ugadi.title: Ugadi
ugadi.description: Ugādi, Yugādi or also known as Saṁvatsarādi, is the first day of the year on the Hindu calendar.
ugadi.name: Ugadi

diwali.title: Diwali
diwali.description: Dipavali, commonly known as Diwali, is the Hindu festival of lights, with variations celebrated in other Indian religions such as Jainism and Sikhism.
diwali.name: Diwali

ganesh_chaturthi.title: Ganesh Chaturthi
ganesh_chaturthi.description: Ganesh Chaturthi, also known as Vinayaka Chaturthi, Vinayaka Chavithi, or Vinayagar Chaturthi, is a Hindu festival celebrating the arrival of the Hindu deity Ganesha to the south of India to meet his brother Karthikeya.
ganesh_chaturthi.name: Vinayaka Chavithi

bathukamma.title: Bathukamma
bathukamma.description: Bathukamma is a flower-festival celebrated by Telugu Hindu women of Telangana and some parts of Andhra Pradesh.
bathukamma.name: Bathukamma

dussehra.title: Vijayadashami
dussehra.description: Vijayadashami, more commonly known as Dasara, or Dassahra, or Dussehra, and also known as Dashāhra or Dashain in Nepali, is a major Hindu festival celebrated every year at the end of Durga Puja and Navaratri.
dussehra.name: Dasara

pongal_festival.title: Pongal (festival)
pongal_festival.description: Pongal is a multi-day Hindu harvest festival celebrated by Tamils.
pongal_festival.name: Pongal festival

kite.title: Kite
kite.description: A kite is a tethered heavier-than-air craft with wing surfaces that react against the air to create lift and drag forces.
kite.name: Kites (galipatam)

diya.title: Diya (lamp)
diya.description: A diya, diyo, deya, deeya, dia, divaa, deepa, deepam, deep, deepak or saaki is an oil lamp made from clay, brass or silver with a cotton wick dipped in oil or ghee.
diya.name: Diya (oil lamp)

puja.title: Puja (Hinduism)
puja.description: Puja is a worship ritual performed by Hindus to offer devotional homage and prayer to one or more deities, to host and honour a guest, or to spiritually celebrate an event.
puja.name: Puja (Hinduism)

aarti.title: Arti (Hinduism)
aarti.description: Arti  or Arartikya is a Hindu ritual employed in worship, part of a puja, in which light from a flame is ritually waved in a clock-wise motion to venerate deities.
aarti.name: Aarti

rangoli.title: Kolam
rangoli.description: Kolam, also known as Muggu, Tarai Alangaram and Rangole, is a form of traditional decorative art that is drawn by using rice flour as per age-old conventions.
rangoli.name: Muggu (rangoli)

veena.title: Saraswati veena
veena.description: The Sarasvatī vīṇa is an ancient Indian plucked veena.
veena.name: Veena

kuchipudi.title: Kuchipudi
kuchipudi.description: Kuchipudi is one of the eight major Indian classical dance forms.
kuchipudi.name: Kuchipudi

bharatanatyam.title: Bharatanatyam
bharatanatyam.description: Bharatanatyam is an Indian classical dance form that comes from Tamil Nadu, India.
bharatanatyam.name: Bharatanatyam

carnatic.title: Carnatic music
carnatic.description: Carnatic music is a system of music commonly associated with South India, including the modern Indian states of Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu and Telangana.
carnatic.name: Carnatic music

cricket.title: Cricket
cricket.description: Cricket is a bat-and-ball game that is played between two teams of eleven players on a field, at the centre of which is a 22-yard pitch with a wicket at each end, each comprising two bails balanced on three stumps.
cricket.name: Cricket

pressure_cooker.title: Pressure cooker
pressure_cooker.description: A pressure cooker is a sealed vessel used for cooking food with the use of high pressure steam and water or a water-based liquid, in a process called pressure cooking.
pressure_cooker.name: Pressure cooker

tawa.title: Tava
tawa.description: The tava(h) / tawa(h) (IPA: [t̪əʋaː], mainly on the Indian subcontinent), saj (IPA: [sˁɑːdʒ]in Arabic), sac (IPA: [sadʒ], in Turkish), and other variations, is a metal cooking utensil.
tawa.name: Tawa

steel_tumbler.title: Indian filter coffee
steel_tumbler.description: Indian filter coffee is a coffee drink made by mixing hot milk and sugar with the infusion obtained by percolation brewing of finely ground coffee powder with chicory in a traditional Indian filter. It has been described as "hot, strong, sweet and topped with bubbly froth" and is known as filter kaapi in India.
steel_tumbler.name: Steel tumbler (davara)

mortar_pestle.title: Mortar and pestle
mortar_pestle.description: A mortar and pestle is a set of two simple tools used to prepare ingredients or substances by crushing and grinding them into a fine paste or powder in the kitchen, laboratory, and pharmacy.
mortar_pestle.name: Grinding stone (rolu)

charpoy.title: Charpai
charpoy.description: Charpai is a traditional woven bed used across Indian subcontinent.
charpoy.name: Charpoy

jhoola.title: Swing (seat)
jhoola.description: A swing is a seat or platform, suspended from chains, ropes, or bars, on which one or more people can swing back and forth for enjoyment or relaxation.
jhoola.name: Swing (uyyala)

rangoli_powder.title: Rangoli
rangoli_powder.description: Rangoli is an art form that originates from the Indian subcontinent, in which patterns are created on the floor or a tabletop using materials such as powdered limestone, red ochre, dry rice flour, coloured sand, quartz powder, flower petals, and coloured rocks.
rangoli_powder.name: Rangoli colours

thanksgiving.title: Thanksgiving (United States)
thanksgiving.description: Thanksgiving is a federal holiday in the United States celebrated on the fourth Thursday of November.
thanksgiving.name: Thanksgiving (United States)

halloween.title: Halloween
halloween.description: Halloween, also known as All Hallows' Eve, or All Saints' Eve, is a celebration observed in many countries on 31 October, the eve of the Western Christian feast of All Hallows' Day.
halloween.name: Halloween

christmas_tree.title: Christmas tree
christmas_tree.description: A Christmas tree is a decorated tree, usually an evergreen conifer such as a spruce, pine or fir, associated with the celebration of Christmas.
christmas_tree.name: Christmas tree

fourth_of_july.title: Independence Day (United States)
fourth_of_july.description: Independence Day, known colloquially as the Fourth of July, is a federal holiday in the United States which commemorates the adoption of the Declaration of Independence on July 4, 1776, establishing the United States of America.
fourth_of_july.name: Fourth of July

hamburger.title: Hamburger
hamburger.description: A hamburger, often known as a burger, consists of fillings—usually a patty of panfried or grilled ground meat, typically beef—placed inside a sliced bun, sesame seed bun, or bread roll.
hamburger.name: Hamburger

pizza.title: Pizza
pizza.description: Pizza is an Italian dish typically consisting of a flat base of leavened wheat-based dough topped with tomato, cheese, and other ingredients, baked at a high temperature, traditionally in a wood-fired oven.
pizza.name: Pizza

hot_dog.title: Hot dog
hot_dog.description: A hot dog is a grilled, steamed, or boiled sausage served in the slit of a partially sliced bun.
hot_dog.name: Hot dog

mac_and_cheese.title: Macaroni and cheese
mac_and_cheese.description: Macaroni and cheese is a pasta dish of macaroni covered in cheese sauce, most commonly cheddar sauce.
mac_and_cheese.name: Macaroni and cheese

pancake.title: Pancake
pancake.description: A pancake, also known as a hotcake, griddlecake, or flapjack, is a flat type of batter bread like cake, often thin and round, prepared from a starch-based batter that may contain eggs, milk, and butter, and then cooked on a hot surface such as a griddle or frying pan.
pancake.name: Pancake

bagel.title: Bagel
bagel.description: A bagel is a bread roll originating in the Jewish communities of Poland.
bagel.name: Bagel

taco.title: Taco
taco.description: A taco is a traditional Mexican dish consisting of a small hand-sized corn- or wheat-based tortilla topped with a filling.
taco.name: Taco

burrito.title: Burrito
burrito.description: A burrito or burro is historically a regional name in Mexico for what in other parts of the country is known as a taco.
burrito.name: Burrito

pbj.title: Peanut butter and jelly sandwich
pbj.description: A peanut butter and jelly sandwich is a sandwich that consists of peanut butter and fruit preserves spread on sandwich bread.
pbj.name: PB&J sandwich

smores.title: S'more
smores.description: A s'more is a confection consisting of a toasted marshmallow and chocolate, sandwiched between graham crackers.
smores.name: S'more

apple_pie.title: Apple pie
apple_pie.description: An apple pie is a fruit pie in which the principal filling is apples.
apple_pie.name: Apple pie

pumpkin_pie.title: Pumpkin pie
pumpkin_pie.description: Pumpkin pie is a dessert pie with a spiced, pumpkin-based custard filling.
pumpkin_pie.name: Pumpkin pie

cereal.title: Breakfast cereal
cereal.description: Breakfast cereal is a category of food, including food products, made from processed cereal grains, that are eaten as part of breakfast or as a snack food, primarily in Western societies.
cereal.name: Breakfast cereal

turkey_dinner.title: Turkey as food
turkey_dinner.description: Turkey meat, commonly referred to simply as turkey, is the meat from turkeys, typically domesticated ones, but also wild turkeys.
turkey_dinner.name: Thanksgiving turkey

baseball.title: Baseball
baseball.description: Baseball is a bat-and-ball sport played between two teams of nine players each, taking turns batting and fielding.
baseball.name: Baseball

american_football.title: American football
american_football.description: American football, referred to simply as football in the United States and Canada and also known as gridiron football, is a team sport played by two teams of eleven players on a rectangular field with goalposts at each end.
american_football.name: Football

basketball.title: Basketball
basketball.description: Basketball is a team sport in which two teams of five players each oppose one another on a rectangular court.
basketball.name: Basketball

snow.title: Snow
snow.description: Snow is a form of solid atmospheric precipitation consisting of individual ice crystals that grow while suspended in the air—usually within clouds—and then fall, accumulating on the ground, where they undergo further changes.
snow.name: Snow

snowman.title: Snowman
snowman.description: A snowman is an anthropomorphic snow sculpture often built in regions with sufficient snowfall and is a very common winter tradition.

school_bus.title: School bus

prom.title: Prom

hiking.title: Hiking

ghee.title: Ghee
ghee.description: Ghee is a type of clarified butter, originating in the Indian Subcontinent.
ghee.name: Ghee

half_saree.title: Langa voni

holi.title: Holi

wedding.title: Hindu wedding
wedding.description: A Hindu wedding, also known as vivaha in Hindi, lagna (लग्न) in Marathi, biyah (बियाह) in Bhojpuri, Maithil Vivah in Maithili, bibaho (বিবাহ) in Bengali, bahaghara (ବାହାଘର) or bibaha (ବିବାହ) in Odia, tirumanam (திருமணம்) in Tamil, pelli (పెళ్లి) in Telugu, maduve (ಮದುವೆ) in Kannada, and kalyanam in Malayalam and other languages, is the traditional marriage ceremony for Hindus.

golu.title: Golu (festival)
golu.description: Golu is the festive display of dolls and figurines in South India during the autumn festive season, particularly around the multiday Navaratri festival of Hinduism.

high_school.title: Secondary school
high_school.description: A secondary school, high school, or senior school, is an institution that provides students with secondary education.

village_market.title: Haat bazaar

monsoon.title: Monsoon
monsoon.description: A monsoon is traditionally a seasonal reversing wind accompanied by corresponding changes in precipitation, but now used to describe seasonal changes in atmospheric circulation and precipitation associated with annual latitudinal oscillation of the Intertropical Convergence Zone, specifically between its limits to the north and south of the equator.

dhoti.title: Veshti

skiing.title: Skiing
skiing.description: Skiing is the use of skis to glide on snow for basic transport, a recreational activity, or a competitive winter sport. Many types of competitive skiing events are recognized by the International Olympic Committee (IOC), and the International Ski and Snowboard Federation (FIS).
skiing.name: Skiing

poornalu.title: Poornalu
